## SK Hynix commits 54 trillion won to domestic NAND capacity while Solidigm reportedly restarts its Dalian fab in China

The Dalian restart is the key risk watch: any escalation in US-China chip restrictions could impair Solidigm's China fab operations, while the 54T KRW domestic commitment shows SK Hynix is hedging geographic exposure — net read is NAND supply growth plus geopolitical overhang.

- SK Hynix is investing 54 trillion won in domestic NAND manufacturing capacity, as stated in the headline.
- Solidigm, SK Hynix's NAND subsidiary, is reportedly restarting Dalian Fab 2 in China — described as 'reported,' indicating this is not yet confirmed.
- The simultaneous domestic build and China restart creates a dual exposure: domestic supply growth alongside China export-control risk.
- High classifier confidence; the investment figure and the geographic split are explicitly named in the headline.
